nt.deckAdjustHint: (for single-card A/B: the deck is changed before Act 1; map and encounters stay the same)

nt.removeEmpty: Nothing removed. Only cards from the starting deck can be picked.
nt.uploadHint: Put mod.yaml plus card/deck YAML files (and an optional hooks.py) in the zip, in the format described in docs/MODDING.md. After upload the simulator test-loads it, and it only joins the mod list above if that works. Used for combat tests only; full runs currently only support the built-in Claude娘 v3.5. hooks.py is Python code that will be executed, so only upload mods you trust.
nt.startHint: Live speed and time remaining are shown once it starts
run.none: No test is running right now
run.noneHint: Start one from "New test", or open a recent test below.
run.cancelQ: Cancel? Results from the finished part won't be saved.
run.failedHint: The run failed; the error is at the end of the log.
rep.noneHint: Reports show up here once a test finishes.
rep.noResult: This test has no readable result file
rep.survivalHint: Share of runs that reached (≥) each floor
rep.overallWin: Overall win rate (weighted by fights per cell)
rep.reportZhOnly: This full report (from the legacy combat simulator) is currently Chinese only; the charts and tables above are in your language.
ab.sameKind: A test of the same type as A
ab.bestFor: Works best with two full-run tests on the same seeds (same character, ascension, runs and first seed) that differ only in the added/removed cards or variants. Pairing by seed then gives the smallest error.
ab.emptyHint: In "New test", run a baseline and a version with the card added on the same seeds, then compare them here.
ab.rateDiffTitle: Rate differences (percentage points, error bars = 95% interval)
ab.monLossA1: HP lost per Act 1 normal fight
ab.noCommonCells: The two tests have no (deck, act, room) cells in common
ab.cellDiffTitle: Win rate difference per cell (B − A, percentage points, error bars = 95% interval, two-proportion z-test)
ab.tooFew: Too few samples to estimate the difference.
ab.paired: Paired by seed: {n} shared seeds ({d} of them with a different floor). Significant = the difference is outside the 95% interval.
ab.unpaired: The two tests share no seeds, so they're treated as independent samples (much larger error than pairing).
hist.noneHint: Every run is saved here automatically.

agent.heuristic.name: Heuristic (fast)
agent.heuristic.desc: Greedy, simulates each action; fastest. Default for full runs
agent.modai.name: General AI (recommended, works with mod characters)
agent.modai.desc: Card picks, rest sites and shops use a small network that only looks at generic numbers (cost, damage, block…); plays cards like the Learned AI. Works with any character, same speed as the Learned AI, works on Windows
agent.modai-boss.name: General AI (boss-fight search)
agent.modai-boss.desc: General AI + simulates whole boss fights ahead; 20–40× slower, Linux/macOS only
agent.learned.name: Learned AI
agent.learned.desc: Strong AI + parameters learned from self-play (CMA-ES); no search, same speed as the Strong AI, works on Windows
agent.learned-search.name: Learned AI (with search)
agent.learned-search.desc: Learned parameters + look-ahead search in elite/boss fights; strongest and slowest, Linux/macOS only
agent.learned-boss.name: Learned AI (search in boss fights only)
agent.learned-boss.desc: Learned parameters, simulates whole boss fights ahead; faster than searching everywhere, Linux/macOS only
agent.strong-nosearch.name: Strong AI (no search)
agent.strong-nosearch.desc: Boss-aware card picks and rests; often used for single-card A/B (old baseline)
agent.strong.name: Strong AI (with search)
agent.search.name: Beam search
agent.mentor-full.name: spire-mentor full-run AI (external)
agent.mentor-full.desc: spire-mentor's MCTS plays the fights and its PPO networks pick cards, paths, shops and rests; base-game characters only (mod characters fall back to the Learned AI); about 30–50 s per run
agent.mentor-full-ev.name: spire-mentor full-run AI + events (external, strongest at A10)
agent.mentor-full-ev.desc: Like the previous one, plus PPO also handles events and upgrade/remove/transform/enchant choices (event text is read from your game install at runtime), with 4000 simulations in boss/elite fights; about 50–130 s per run
agent.mentorHint: Build the external spire-mentor yourself, set DECKBENCH_MENTOR_SITE / DECKBENCH_MENTOR_PY and restart (see docs/DEVELOPER.md)
agentc.heuristic.name: Heuristic (fast)
agentc.heuristic.desc: Greedy; doesn't plan for the next turn
agentc.beam.name: Beam search
agentc.beam.desc: Width 4, depth 4; finds combos that need setting up, slow

preset.beam_compare: Heuristic vs. beam-search AI (Act 1 starter + archetype decks)
